name: TBS Regional Finals 2027
venue: Sports Hall, The British School, Dr Jose P Rizal Marg, Chanakyapuri, New Delhi 110021
scrutineeringInfo: Bring your car fully assembled with wheels fitted and the cartridge chamber empty. Scrutineers will check overall length, width, wheel diameter, body mass and the cartridge chamber depth against the Technical Regulations. Cars that fail may be corrected and resubmitted before 09:45. Bring your own callipers if you want to check dimensions in the pits first.
whatToBring: Race car and a spare set of wheels
Verbal presentation on a USB stick and a laptop
Pit display boards and team uniform
Packed lunch and a refillable water bottle
